PARAN UMAR TARAWALLY, and National Cohesion Act, 2020.

Being an Act to provide for the establishment of the
Independent Commission for Peace and National Cohesion; to confer
on the Commission the power to take measures to prevent, manage
and resolve conflicts; to build, promote and maintain sustainable
peace in Sierra Leone; and to provide for other related matters.

mencement.

present Parliament assembled.
